description: The Palestinian Central Bureau of Statistics published the Housing Report of the 2017 Population, Housing and Establishments Census as a bilingual Arabic and English PDF with its 39 tables also in an Excel workbook. The tables count occupied housing units, persons and households in Palestine by type of locality (urban, rural and camps) and cover the main source of drinking water, improved water and sanitation, connection to electricity from the public network or a private generator, type of toilet facility (public sewer, cesspit, septic tank, open drain), main energy for cooking and heating, information technology tools and methods of solid waste disposal, besides rooms, area, tenure and density. A definitions chapter explains each category. Coverage is national: 852,534 of 866,329 occupied housing units were connected to the public electricity network and 2,054 used a private generator. Format and access: free PDF and XLSX downloads, no registration. Licence: not stated on the pages read. Caveats: no governorate or locality breakdown in these tables; the data exclude the part of Jerusalem annexed by Israel in 1967; the figures describe 2017 and do not reflect later damage. Simulation uses: baseline shares of water, sewer, electricity and energy sources for service restoration and resilience studies. Related records: the PCBS 2017 census completed buildings by use and the Palestinian Water Authority water sector facts and figures.
